name: Europe hybrid attacks
value: GRU-linked arson plot in Estonia, 14 Nov
summary: Estonia blames Russia's GRU for a 14 Nov sabotage attempt on a drone maker and closes its Russian border from 1 Dec
state: Estonia attributes a 14 Nov attempt to blow up and burn the Threod Systems drone plant in Viimsi to Russian military intelligence; eight suspects were detained in Latvia (Kyiv Post). Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna said on 16 Nov that all crossings with Russia will close from 1 Dec (Defense News). A state-attributed sabotage plot keeps Watch; searches to 27 Nov found no sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
for_you: Follow police and national security service advice; report suspicious activity near infrastructure. Travellers to Estonia should check FCDO advice on border closures.
rubric_hit: Sabotage plot attributed to a state (Russia's GRU, Estonia)

why: Sabotage, arson and drone incursions over airports and bases are how state confrontation reaches daily life in the UK and Europe.
drivers: Russia–NATO tensions, drone and cyber capabilities, proxy recruitment, elections.

rubric.alert: Repeated airport or infrastructure shutdowns across several countries, or sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
rubric.watch: Drone incursions close an airport or military base, or a sabotage incident is attributed to a state.
